Copy Markdown Open The runtime platform for cloud agents Revyl gives agents a runtime to run and verify software, and your team a shared record of what it does. Search the docs ⌘ K 
 From code changes to observed behavior Copy Anchor Link 
 Coding and cloud agents can write changes faster than a person can watch them run.
A diff shows what changed in the code, not what happens when someone uses the app.
What the team knows about that behavior is spread across tests, recordings, bug reports,
and the people who last worked on it. 
 Revyl connects the change to a run you can inspect, then keeps what the run observed
so the next person or agent can use it. 
 Run, verify, and ask again Copy Anchor Link 
 Start with an intent: a pull request to verify, or a question about your app.
Your coding agent or the Revyl agent runs the software in a runtime suited to the work,
such as an app  session  or a  computer  (Alpha).
Revyl works with the agent you already use. 
 The run leaves evidence you can open.  Proof of changes  adds a verdict
about the changed behavior. A  session  keeps its recording and report.
A  computer  keeps its activity and desktop recording;
its app sessions have their own reports. 
 App-session observations feed  Atlas , your company's shared behavioral record.
People query it in the dashboard, and agents query it through the  CLI .
You can follow an observed path, inspect its evidence, or find a gap to explore next.
Atlas records what ran, not everything your app might do. 
 
 Atlas shows an observed screen and its transitions to other screens. 
 Next steps Copy Anchor Link 
 
 Set up proof of changes  to get a verdict on your pull requests before review. 
 Connect your coding agent  to run and verify changes from the place you write code. 
 Install the CLI  to start sessions, run checks, and query Atlas from your terminal. 
 Open Atlas  to follow observed flows and inspect the evidence behind them. 
 
 See it in Revyl Copy Anchor Link 
 Proof of changes See the verdict and the evidence for a pull request. Atlas Follow a flow through the screens Revyl has observed. Agent actions Inspect what your agent did and what it checked. Runtimes Browse live and past sessions, including Web (Alpha). Builds Bring builds from your CI, or build on Revyl's runners.
